name: C0* product document package
source: Extracted from the 01.ROCKBOX shipped-product structure; generic (exemplar only, no client content).
numbering_note: RockBox numbers PRD as C07; the genesis-first variant uses C00. Both map to key 'prd'.
contract: Every section declares the four capabilities so the MCP+skills know, per layer, WHAT to fill, HOW to elicit it, WHICH tool generates it, and WHICH tool verifies it. `coverage` flags status: full | partial | gap.

roles.constraints: bodesign supplies constraints only; the deliverable is produced downstream.
roles.track+interface: owned by another team; bodesign records interface constraints + keeps them in sync.
roles.draft+guide: bodesign drafts a plan + readiness guide; actual execution is outsourced.

question_bank.label: Compute (MCU/SoC/NPU)
question_bank.question: Which exact MCU/SoC part and package? (e.g. STM32N657 VFBGA223)

question_bank.label: Connectivity
question_bank.question: Which connectivity standard(s) and exact module? (cellular / Wi-Fi / BLE / Ethernet)

question_bank.label: Memory / storage
question_bank.question: Flash/RAM type, density, and interface? (e.g. 8 GB eMMC vs octal-SPI NOR)

question_bank.label: Power input
question_bank.question: Power input connector and voltage range? (USB-C PD profile? DC input?)

question_bank.label: Charging
question_bank.question: Charging current and charger IC preference? cell chemistry to charge?

question_bank.label: Battery
question_bank.question: Battery: cell count/config, capacity, and protection/fuel-gauge needs?

question_bank.label: Form factor / dimensions
question_bank.question: Target board dimensions / form-factor or enclosure constraints?

question_bank.label: Compliance targets
question_bank.question: Any compliance targets? (FCC / CE / EMC / safety)

question_bank.label: Build volume
question_bank.question: Prototype or production volume? (affects sourcing and DFM)
